entry.name: HolySiteDescription
entry.value: Feature that provides a research reward to the first Sisters of Battle unit that enters the tile.

entry.name: HolySiteFlavor
entry.value: The Tabernacles of the Adepta Sororitas are not merely holy sites—they also house relics of ancient Sisters, weapons, armour and valuable tactical advice. In times of dire need, the Sisters may take them up again and use them in war…
